name: Halma plc

geography.fx_notes: USA is the largest destination market (~40%+, ESTIMATE), followed by Mainland Europe, UK and Asia-Pacific; >75% of sales in US, Europe and UK (Morningstar/PitchBook profile). kpis.value: ~20% of group revenue; photonics grew 52% in FY26 contributing ~8pp of organic growth; FY27 expected +30% (~5pp of group growth)

company_fcf.definition: Company cash conversion (adjusted operating cash flow / adjusted EBIT) 93%

lease.source_id: IFRS filer; not extracted this run

management.senior_turnover_5y: Orderly: CEO succession Andrew Williamson -> Marc Ronchetti (internal)
management.guidance_record: Strong: 23rd consecutive year of record profit; FY26 well ahead of targets

guidance.value: In line with FY2026 (22.7%) excl. Nuvonic one-off
Organic revenue growth 5%+, EBIT margin 19-23%, ROTIC 12%+, cash conversion 90%+, leverage up to 2x

evidence: Safety/Healthcare products driven by regulation and replacement [S1]
A.rationale: Core regulated niches are durable, but a single 20% customer on project-like optical switches lowers durability to average.

evidence: Regulation-driven safety niches (fire, gas detection) with 26.8% margins [S1]
B.rationale: Accreditation/regulatory and specification niches with demonstrable pricing power.

evidence: Niche leadership rather than group scale

E.rationale: Balanced developed mix but US now >40%.

evidence: FY27 photonics growth +30% => share rising toward ~23% (ESTIMATE)
Management flags data-centre supply-side constraints and technology-choice risk [S1]
I2.rationale: AI/data-centre dependence ~20% of revenue: in the 15-25% band.

ai.notes: FACT: single large hyperscaler technology customer (Avo Photonics, optical switches for data centres) = ~20% of group revenue in FY2026, expected to grow ~30% in FY2027. This is direct AI/data-centre capex exposure.

sector_specific.notes: ai_dc_pct FACT (FY2026). acquisition_growth_pct = FY2026 revenue contribution (FACT). Fire safety tied to non-res construction (share not extracted). Halma is NOT an AI diversifier on current mix.

gates.notes: G3 -> B: single customer ~20% of group revenue (>15%). G5 -> B: AI/data-centre-tied revenue ~20% (>15%), rising toward ~23% in FY27 (ESTIMATE); would move to A if >30%. G1 ~1x. G4 cash conversion 93%.

bull_points: Regulated safety/environmental/healthcare niches with 23-27% margins and 23 years of profit growth (S1)
Ex-photonics organic growth still ~8% with record, accretive M&A (S1)
bear_points: 20% of revenue from one hyperscaler optical-switch programme - concentration and AI-capex cyclicality (S1)
Technology-choice risk in fast-moving data-centre optics (management's own caveat) (S1)
Record and larger acquisitions (E2S largest ever) raise integration/return risk (S1)
thesis_breakers: Hyperscaler customer share rising above 30% of revenue (G5 -> A)
Loss of a generation of the hyperscaler programme or photonics revenue decline >20%
